member.name: T:Labyrinthian.Maze
member.summary: Class representating a graph-based maze. It consists of two undirected graphs: base graph and passages graph.

remarks.para:
Each node of the base graph represents a maze cell or a special cell with a negative index, that is not the maze part and used to draw exterior walls.
Each edge of the base graph represents a possible wall/passage, if one of the nodes of the edge is not the maze part then this edge is an exterior wall.

Each node of the passages graph represents a maze cell.
Each edge of the passages graph represent passage between two maze cells.
Base graph is created inside the constructor and passages graph should be initialized inside the class
